# A goal along a lineage

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`a-goal-along-a-lineage` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](a-goal-along-a-lineage.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> A goal carried at each step passes down a lineage where it passes across each descent and each member keeps it until it gives; descendants of carriers carry it exactly where it passes across every descent from a carrier.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Along a lineage, with the goal passed at each descent and kept until each member gives, every member carries it from its first standing step. (`Becoming.Flow.goal_along`)
2. Passing across every descent from a carrier is equivalent to the goal passing down every lineage whose members keep it, from a carrying founder. (`Becoming.Flow.goal_descends_iff`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom; the goal is any predicate of steps and formations.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That any goal passes across a descent: the condition is not derived from descent.

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · A relation omitted by a weaker description does not refute the fuller account.
